cohorts.citation: L. J. Janicki and H. Appledorf (1974), Journal of Food Science 39, 715–717. Methods and Table 2 (p. 716).
cohorts.measurement: Four cooking treatments, 12 patties per treatment. Use the single published raw-group mean of 107.5 g and the cooked-group mean of each treatment. Individual paired starting weights and cooked observations are not published. Raw crude fat 18.1 g / 107.5 g = 16.84% sets the medium-fat class independently of cooked outcomes.

cohorts.citation: E. P. Williams (2022), National Ground Beef Survey–2021, Texas A&M University. Methods §3.1 and Table 11, sensory panel cook yields.
cohorts.measurement: All nine packaging x package-lean-percentage strata in the sensory cook-yield section. Observations are published least-squares means of measured cooked/raw yields in percent. A 100 g input normalizes the endpoint; the study formed 151.2 g patties and does not report corresponding stratum mean cooked weights in grams. nPackages counts packages, not repeated independent observations for scoring.
